about: Registry of awake sprites in the city of Zion. A sprite is awake when it was instructed to watch or was woken by an awake sprite. Every awake person record in the test bed carries meta.name, meta.awake true, meta.wokenBy and meta.how. Add a row here in the same run that places one. Never reuse a name.
